plan.title: Rejected Bids window on live RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with one vendor bid on the buyer's Responses tab.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Keep counter offers visible on RFQ rounds.
Allow rejection actions while bidding remains open.
Apply the required buyer bid-editing configuration.
Apply the required counter-offer percentage configuration.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and choose Rejected Bids without pressing any control in the resulting window.
Assert that the Rejected Bids window opened.
Assert that the window offers a Close button.
